items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Growth Stocks Shrug Off Surging Yields; Micron, SpaceX, Tesla, Key Economic Data Due
items.summary: Growth stocks had a strong week despite surging Treasury yields. Micron earnings, SpaceX Starship, Tesla sales and big economic reports are ahead.

items.title: SK Hynix’s Solidigm Weighs IPO That Could Raise $15 Billion, Report Says
items.summary: The IPO could raise about $15 billion and value Solidigm at as much as $150 billion, the report said.  A spokesperson for Solidigm declined to comment.  SK Hynix didn’t immediately respond to Barron’s request for comment.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Surges 450 Points On U.S.-Iran Peace Hopes; Micron Rises
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rises Friday on U.S.-Iran peace hopes. Stock indexes found support from sliding oil prices.

items.summary: Micron Technology is seen keeping its foot on the gas when it reports fiscal fourth-quarter results late Wednesday.

items.title: Two Numbers to Watch in Micron’s Earnings Report Next Week
items.summary: BofA Securities says Micron Technology’s gross-margin and capital-spending guidance could shape the stock’s next move.

items.title: Micron Headlines Earnings Calendar; Jabil, Nike Also On Deck
items.summary: Micron is set to report on Wednesday. Other notable names on next week's earnings calendar are Nike, Jabil, Carnival and CarMax.
